category: file transfer service (free, Premium and Family plans)

free_tier.stated: Free forever, no card: send files up to 50 GB, 15 GB of storage, 6 GB a day of bandwidth, share links last up to 7 days.

per_object_cap.stated: 50 GB per file on Free; 500 GB on Premium and Family

retention.stated: share links last up to 7 days on Free; deleted-file recovery is 7 days

egress.terms: 6 GB a day on Free; 10 TB a month on Premium; extra bandwidth is $3.00 per TB and extra storage $5.00 per TB.

interface_detail: Browser uploader with link and email sharing; no API page was read.
tooling: Browser only on the pages read.
chaining: Premium is $9.99 per month for 1 TB of storage, 10 TB of monthly bandwidth and files up to 500 GB; extra storage is $5.00 per TB.

limits.value: 50 GB per file on Free, 500 GB on Premium and Family
6 GB a day of bandwidth and 15 GB of storage on Free
share links last up to 7 days on Free

binding_note: 6 GB a day of bandwidth is the free tier ceiling that a multi-file retrieval meets first.

identity_cost.detail: The how-to page states that neither the sender nor the recipient needs an account to send up to 50 GB; Premium is a paid account with a card.

reliability_note: Share links expire after 7 days on the free tier.
confidence_note: Plans read on the vendor pricing and how-to pages. Whether the free uploader works over a scripted client was not probed.

evidence.quote: Send files up to 50 GB for free. Neither you nor your recipient needs an account.
evidence.proved: sending up to 50 GB is free with no account
